<a id="api-applyFieldCustomizations"></a>

## [FUNCTION] `applyFieldCustomizations`

Projects display overrides and additive custom fields onto a cloned object schema.

Pure projection: existing validation constraints are never removed or weakened.

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-plugins/field-customization`, `@alneas/eaos-plugins/field-customization/react`, `@alneas/eaos-plugins/field-customization/schema`.

### Signature

```typescript
declare function applyFieldCustomizations<T extends ObjectSchema>(base: T, fields: Record<string, FieldCustomization>): T;
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | `T` | Yes | Canonical object schema; original validation constraints are preserved. |
| `fields` | `Record<string, FieldCustomization>` | Yes | Overrides keyed by field name; new custom_ fields require a supported explicit type. |

### Returns

`T`

A deep-cloned schema with display metadata and added required fields.

### Type parameters

- `T`: JSON-schema-like object shape preserved by the projection.

### Remarks

This pure projection does not validate all service input constraints. Existing field types/enums remain unchanged; false is_required never removes a base requirement. Prototype keys and unknown non-custom fields are skipped.

### Errors and rejections

May throw if base contains values unsupported by structuredClone.

### Example

```typescript
import { applyFieldCustomizations } from '@alneas/eaos-plugins/field-customization/schema';
const schema = applyFieldCustomizations({ type: 'object', properties: { title: { type: 'string' } } }, { title: { display_label: 'Report title' }, custom_note: { type: 'string', help_text: 'Optional note' } });
```


<a id="api-createExtension"></a>

## [FUNCTION] `createExtension`

Builds a host extension restricted to a verified, concrete tenant catalog.

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-plugins/field-customization/runtime`.

### Signature

```typescript
declare function createExtension(input: {
    tenantIds: string[];
    bindings?: PublicPluginBindings;
}): {
    apiVersion: 1;
    id: string;
    tenantIds: string[];
    manifests: _alneas_eaos_core.PluginManifest[];
    lifecycle: _alneas_eaos_server_lifecycle_engine.LifecyclePlugin[];
    routeFactories: {
        [x: string]: (options?: any) => any;
    };
};
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `{     tenantIds: string[];     bindings?: PublicPluginBindings; }` | Yes | Nonempty distinct concrete tenantIds plus required live bindings; wildcard IDs are rejected. |

### Returns

`{     apiVersion: 1;     id: string;     tenantIds: string[];     manifests: _alneas_eaos_core.PluginManifest[];     lifecycle: _alneas_eaos_server_lifecycle_engine.LifecyclePlugin[];     routeFactories: {         [x: string]: (options?: any) => any;     }; }`

An API-version-1 extension containing tenant IDs, configured manifest, lifecycle and route factories.

### Remarks

This validates adapter presence and tenant admission, not the truth of host authorization. No activation or migration is executed. Principals outside the configured catalog resolve to null.

### Errors and rejections

Error for empty/duplicate/wildcard tenant IDs or missing host adapter functions.

### Public members

#### `input.tenantIds`

Verified nonempty catalog of distinct concrete tenant IDs; wildcards are rejected.


#### `input.bindings`

Required live host options and identity resolver; omitted bindings throw.



### Example

```typescript
import { createExtension, type PublicPluginBindings } from '@alneas/eaos-plugins/field-customization/runtime';
export function configureExtension(tenantIds: string[], bindings: PublicPluginBindings) { return createExtension({ tenantIds, bindings }); }
```

```typescript
interface FieldCustomizationOptions {

    resolveSchema(principal: PluginPrincipal, resource: string): Promise<ObjectSchema | null>;
}
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `store` | `PluginRecordStore<FieldDefinition>` | Yes | Tenant/resource-isolated durable definition storage with atomic compare-and-swap replace. |
| `authorize` | `Promise<boolean>` | Yes | Live lifecycle, membership and resource permission check for read/write; false denies access. |
| `resolveSchema` | `Promise<ObjectSchema \| null>` | Yes | Resolve the current canonical object schema for an authorized resource; null makes the resource unavailable. |

Type declaration; no runtime value.

### Public members

#### `store`

Tenant/resource-isolated durable definition storage with atomic compare-and-swap replace.


#### `authorize`

Live lifecycle, membership and resource permission check for read/write; false denies access.

Parameters:

- `principal`: Verified tenant principal for this operation.
- `action`: Requested plugin action to authorize against current state.

Returns: True only when current host policy allows access; false denies access.

### Remarks

<a id="api-FieldCustomizationService"></a>

## [CLASS] `FieldCustomizationService`

Reads and revision-checks tenant/resource field overrides without weakening base schema validation.

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-plugins/field-customization`, `@alneas/eaos-plugins/field-customization/service`.

### Signature

```typescript
declare class FieldCustomizationService {
    constructor(options: FieldCustomizationOptions);
    read(p: PluginPrincipal, resource: string): Promise<{
        id: string;
        revision: number;
        fields: Record<string, FieldCustomization>;
        schema: ObjectSchema;
    }>;
    write(p: PluginPrincipal, resource: string, input: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<{
        id: string;
        revision: number;
        fields: Record<string, FieldCustomization>;
        schema: ObjectSchema;
    }>;
}
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `FieldCustomizationOptions` | Yes | Tenant-isolated storage, live resource authorization and canonical object schema resolver. |

### Returns

`FieldCustomizationService`

### Remarks

Server-side host supplies current resource authorization, canonical object schema resolution and durable isolated storage. A write can persist before a final authorization check rejects; reload current state before retrying.

### Constructor contract

### Public members

#### `read`

Reads a resource definition and merges its overrides into the current canonical schema.

Parameters:

- `p`: Verified tenant principal.
- `resource`: Nonblank host-catalog resource ID.

Returns: Resource ID, revision, fields and projected schema; absent definitions use revision 0 and empty fields.

### Errors and rejections

Rejects invalid principal/resource, denied/revoked access (403), unavailable object schema (404), and propagated host failures.

Example:

```typescript
import { FieldCustomizationService } from '@alneas/eaos-plugins/field-customization/service';
import type { PluginPrincipal } from '@alneas/eaos-server/plugin-data';
export function readFields(service: FieldCustomizationService, principal: PluginPrincipal, resource: string) { return service.read(principal, resource); }
```


#### `write`

Replaces the complete field override map using resource-scoped optimistic concurrency.

Parameters:

- `p`: Verified current tenant principal.
- `resource`: Host-catalog resource ID.
- `input`: Exactly revision (nonnegative integer, 0 for new definition) and fields (at most 100 overrides).

Returns: The new definition revision, copied fields and projected schema.

### Remarks

Omitted fields are removed. Existing required base fields cannot be hidden or weakened; new names use custom_ prefix and a supported scalar type. Text is limited to 2000 characters, order magnitude to 10000 and string enum choices to 100. Final authorization occurs after persistence, so a rejection may follow a committed write.

### Errors and rejections

Rejects malformed/weakening overrides (400), denied/revoked access (403), unavailable schema (404), stale revision/CAS conflict (409), and host failures.

Example:

```typescript
import { FieldCustomizationService } from '@alneas/eaos-plugins/field-customization/service';
import type { PluginPrincipal } from '@alneas/eaos-server/plugin-data';
export async function renameTitle(service: FieldCustomizationService, principal: PluginPrincipal, resource: string) {
 const current = await service.read(principal, resource);
 return service.write(principal, resource, { revision: current.revision, fields: { ...current.fields, title: { ...current.fields.title, display_label: 'Report title' } } });
}
```



### Example

```typescript
import { FieldCustomizationService, type FieldCustomizationOptions } from '@alneas/eaos-plugins/field-customization/service';
export function connectFields(options: FieldCustomizationOptions) { return new FieldCustomizationService(options); }
```

<a id="api-PublicPluginBindings"></a>

## [INTERFACE] `PublicPluginBindings`

Live host service configuration and current authenticated principal resolver.

Imports: `@alneas/eaos-plugins/field-customization/runtime`.

### Signature

```typescript
interface PublicPluginBindings {
    options: FieldCustomizationOptions;
    resolvePrincipal(context: Context): Promise<PluginPrincipal | null>;
}
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `FieldCustomizationOptions` | Yes | Live plugin service/storage/authorization configuration. |
| `resolvePrincipal` | `Promise<PluginPrincipal \| null>` | Yes | Resolve current verified Hono request identity, or null to deny access; rejection propagates. |

### Returns

Type declaration; no runtime value.

### See also

FieldCustomizationService for a complete host integration example.

### Public members

#### `options`

Live plugin service/storage/authorization configuration.


#### `resolvePrincipal`

Resolve current verified Hono request identity, or null to deny access; rejection propagates.

Parameters:

- `context`: Current Hono request context.

Returns: A verified current principal, or null to deny admission.

### Errors and rejections

Propagates host adapter or SDK failures; async methods reject their Promise.

Example:

```typescript
import type { PublicPluginBindings } from '@alneas/eaos-plugins/field-customization/runtime';
export function resolveRequest(bindings: PublicPluginBindings, context: Parameters<PublicPluginBindings['resolvePrincipal']>[0]) {
 return bindings.resolvePrincipal(context); // Null denies unauthenticated or unavailable identity.
}
```

Exposes the canonical platform-records schema used by the plugin storage contract.

### Signature


### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| — | — | — | No call parameters. |

### Returns

`Declared constant value.`

### Remarks

This references getPlatformRecordsContract().schema; the plugin does not own a separate table schema.
